GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (visors off) Jumped Ok Went Forward led by 1 length . passed coming To The Turn , was laying out & Quickly Beaten off # led/found nought
Jumped Ok Settled in 5th 4 Lengths . shifted about Under Pressure in Straight , tired Inside 200m # couldn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to shift about under pressure in the straight

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ended up 6th 4 Lengths . Straightened Up in Middle Of Track 5 Lengths off, Quickly Battling # didn't finish off

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: as there was no other rider available, Stewards permitted A. Stead to  ride the mare 1.5kg over its allotted weight. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the  event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Settled 2nd last 14 Lengths . came widest in Straight , Made Some Ground but never looked like figuring # tardy/never in it

Jumped Ok , sat back 3rd last Two Wide 4 Lengths 800m, worked into the frace Middle Of Track before the corner. kept grinding away last 200m and was not far off minor placing, blinkers off again, visors first time # grinding effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early stages of the event. RE after being crossed near the 1100m the mare began to race ungenerously and resented the kickback.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex matthew seyers) jumped awkwardly went to 6th 6 Lengths . Straightened Up out in Middle Of Track , tired from 200m # found nothing
Jumped Ok Settled 7th on rail 6 Lengths . came Wide on Turn , ran about Under Pressure , Quickly Battling (winner led & bolted in) # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: near the 200m was inconvenienced when contacted by a/r which shifted in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , did it tough rolling forward to share lead Two Wide 1000m, Headed on the corner but dug deep and battled on well enough at the one pace, winkers off again # battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped away awkwardly and shifted in. Raced wide  without cover until the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 5th 5 Lengths . Hard Ridden into Straight , was one paced but got going late to finish a # distant 3rd

Jumped Ok , Settled touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 10 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along between runners soon after Straightening Up , was weaving Through and making ground last 200m, ran out of ground last 100m and she should have arguably ran into minor placing, blinkers off again, winkers again # unlucky late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: shifted out around heels to obtain clear running near the 200m. Laid  in marginally approaching the 100m and became awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began only fairly ended up going keenly out Wide working to 5th 3 Lengths . continued on & Took A Sit 2nd 1 length near 800m. Took over on Turn , bumped Soon After Straightening Up , Quickly Beaten off # early work told
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly and wide in the early and middle stages of the event
